title: FIBRE
prompt: The least glamorous, most missed | Two kinds, two jobs | It feeds your gut bacteria | Add it slowly. Drink water. | Not medical advice
style: warm documentary photography, morning kitchen light, natural textures, soft shadows, muted earthy palette, shallow depth of field, high detail
line: Fibre is the least glamorous thing on this list and probably the one most people are short on. Some of it dissolves and slows digestion. Some of it does not, and keeps things moving. It also feeds the bacteria in your gut, which is where a lot of the current research is pointed. One practical note: add it slowly and drink water, or you will regret the enthusiasm. General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
